$themes.$description: The surface every www.hitchd.com page paints signed out: one light theme across the marketing pages, the couple auth app and the guest registry app — no dark variant or theme control exists anywhere, so no dark set ships. Hitchd declares almost no custom properties; the values are measured computed styles with per-leaf evidence in $extensions.source.
